scope: Local regression and real stdio MCP/CLI with disposable synthetic projects. No model turn, Codex App Server, Oracle, deployment or native application-browser verification. UTF-8 response bytes are not billed tokens.
changes: Six long MCP tools wait up to25 seconds by default for their existing durable job;0 queues immediately.
One to eight metadata requests are validated before SQL and share one target verification; queries preserve bounds, order and untrusted-content marking.
Single work uses current_session and returns pure projectSummary; optional project.inspect summary performs no source reads.
Compact MCP results preserve nested operation outcomes, diagnostics, artifact IDs and plan review details; archived full output remains recoverable.
Terminal job outcomes also propagate through the outer MCP envelope and isError; pending jobs no longer claim operation completion.

metadataBatch.scope: Deterministic dispatch assertion; not live Oracle performance.

limitations: Model turns and billed-token savings are not measured.
Oracle performance and actual APEX editing latency are not measured.
Newly installed skills and tools require a fresh Codex session.
publication: Local development and installation only; no commit, push, tag or registry publication.
